name: Dun Huang Plaza
summary: Dun Huang Plaza is a vibrant multi-level Asian shopping center in Houston's Chinatown district, featuring authentic restaurants, supermarkets, specialty shops, and cultural services. With over 2,300 positive reviews, it serves as a beloved community hub offering everything from traditional bakeries and tea houses to modern entertainment and professional services.
demographics: Dun Huang Plaza primarily serves Houston's Asian-American community, particularly Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese populations in the Chinatown district along Bellaire Boulevard. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income households seeking authentic Asian groceries, restaurants, and services. Visitors include multi-generational families, young professionals, and food enthusiasts from across the Greater Houston area who travel specifically for the authentic Asian dining and shopping experience. The center draws both local residents for daily needs and destination shoppers willing to drive from surrounding suburbs for specialty items and cultural amenities.
description: Dun Huang Plaza stands as a cornerstone of Houston's vibrant Chinatown district on Bellaire Boulevard, serving as a cultural and commercial hub for the city's diverse Asian-American community. This multi-level shopping center features an extensive collection of authentic Asian restaurants, supermarkets, specialty shops, and professional services spread across three floors. The plaza offers visitors an immersive experience with businesses ranging from traditional bakeries and tea houses to modern KTV entertainment venues, hair salons, and cosmetics shops specializing in Korean and Japanese beauty products. Beyond retail, Dun Huang Plaza houses essential community services including CPA offices, insurance agents, realtors, travel agencies, and educational facilities offering dancing, kung fu, and music instruction. With operating hours from 9 AM to 11 PM daily and a strong 4.4-star rating from over 2,300 reviews, the plaza has established itself as a beloved destination where authentic Asian culture, cuisine, and commerce converge in the heart of Houston.
